name: Laghu Vishagarbha Taila (Oil)

sections.introduction: Laghu Vishagarbha Taila (Oil) is an ayurvedic formulation which is formulated from the mixture of herbs. This medicine is known to treat problems related with vata disorders.
sections.ingredients:
Til taila – Sesamum indicum’s oil 
 Bhusi kwath – Psyllium husk 
 Kaner mool kwath – Nerium indicum’s root kwath 
 Dhattura svarasa – Datura Stramonium’s juice 
 Nirgundi ke patte ka svarasa – Vitex negundo leaves’s juice 
 Aak svarasa – Calotropis procera leaves’s juice 
 Jatamansi kwath – Nardostachys jatamansi kwath 
 Dhattura beej – Datura Stramonium’s seeds 
 Kuth – Saussurea costus 
 Priyangu – Callicarpa Macrophylla 
 Bachnag – Aconitum ferox 
 Satyanashi – Argemone maxicana 
 Rasna safed – Lepidagathis trinervis 
 Kaneri mool – Nerium indicum’s root 
 Malkangni – Celastrus paniculatus 
 Kaali mircha – piper nigrum 
 Danti mool – Baliospermum montanum’s root 
 Jatamansi – Nardostachys jatamansi 
 Chitrak mool – Plumbago zeylanica’s root 
 Devdaaru – Cedrus deodara 
 Pili sarson – Brassica rapa 
 Haldi – curcuma longa 
 Daaruhaldi – Berberis aristata 
 Arandi mool – Ricinus communis’s root 
 Laakh – Coccus lacca 
 Triphala 
 Majistha – Rubia cordifolia 

 Method of Preparation 

 First, take the ingredients from number one to seven up to 3072 grams and mixed to taila. 
 Now take all other ingredients up to 48 grams and mixed with taila. 
 Keep the above mixture in sun for seven days and then just strain the mixture. 
 Then keep in the sun during winters for 21 days.
sections.dose:
Used to apply externally only. 
 Used for massage.
sections.indications:
Vata dosha related diseases 
 Paralysis 
 Tremors 
 Neck rigidity 
 Stiffness in limbs
sections.contraindications:
Avoid if pregnant and in infants. 
 Avoid oral intake 
 Use under doctor’s prescription. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Laghu Vishagarbha Taila (Oil) 
 Reference – Rasatantra Sara (first part); edition 13; 842 – 843. 
 Introduction 
 Laghu Vishagarbha Taila (Oil) is an ayurvedic formulation which is formulated from the mixture of herbs. This medicine is known to treat problems related with vata disorders. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Til taila – Sesamum indicum’s oil 
 Bhusi kwath – Psyllium husk 
 Kaner mool kwath – Nerium indicum’s root kwath 
 Dhattura svarasa – Datura Stramonium’s juice 
 Nirgundi ke patte ka svarasa – Vitex negundo leaves’s juice 
 Aak svarasa – Calotropis procera leaves’s juice 
 Jatamansi kwath – Nardostachys jatamansi kwath 
 Dhattura beej – Datura Stramonium’s seeds 
 Kuth – Saussurea costus 
 Priyangu – Callicarpa Macrophylla 
 Bachnag – Aconitum ferox 
 Satyanashi – Argemone maxicana 
 Rasna safed – Lepidagathis trinervis 
 Kaneri mool – Nerium indicum’s root 
 Malkangni – Celastrus paniculatus 
 Kaali mircha – piper nigrum 
 Danti mool – Baliospermum montanum’s root 
 Jatamansi – Nardostachys jatamansi 
 Chitrak mool – Plumbago zeylanica’s root 
 Devdaaru – Cedrus deodara 
 Pili sarson – Brassica rapa 
 Haldi – curcuma longa 
 Daaruhaldi – Berberis aristata 
 Arandi mool – Ricinus communis’s root 
 Laakh – Coccus lacca 
 Triphala 
 Majistha – Rubia cordifolia 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 First, take the ingredients from number one to seven up to 3072 grams and mixed to taila. 
 Now take all other ingredients up to 48 grams and mixed with taila. 
 Keep the above mixture in sun for seven days and then just strain the mixture. 
 Then keep in the sun during winters for 21 days. 
 
 Dose 
 
 Used to apply externally only. 
 Used for massage. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Vata dosha related diseases 
 Paralysis 
 Tremors 
 Neck rigidity 
 Stiffness in limbs 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Avoid if pregnant and in infants. 
 Avoid oral intake 
 Use under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
